data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month; individually opt in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Fisher01–24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25: 50 remain; next stock500 or100. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Recovery and long-run gains aren't guaranteed; you're free to decline.
